table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale' else item.name end, 
			altersaleinvcode=max(saleledger.altersaleinvcode),
			users.username,  
			salecat=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
			custref=max(saleledger.custrefno),
			saleledger.custcode,
			headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
			customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
			headerinvno=max(saleledger.headerinvno),
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         dbo.saleledger.date,
         dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
         dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
         dbo.saledetail.icode,   
         dbo.saledetail.gcode, 
         cashreceived=max(dbo.saleledger.cashreceived),
			Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),  
         looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
			packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
			packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	 		saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	 		rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
         salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
		itemgstperc=saledetail.gstperc,
		itemunitsalestax=saledetail.unitsalestax,
         discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
			customername='                                  '  ,
			itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
			aliasname=item.customicode,
			machinename=',' +  max(saleledger.machinename),
			totaltaxonInv=dbo.fn_gettaxonsaleinv(saleledger.saleinvcode)

    FROM dbo.saleledger,   
         dbo.saledetail,  
         item,
			Users 

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
			( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode ) and
			( saledetail.icode = item.icode )


GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.headerno,
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks, 
			saledetail.icode, 
			saledetail.gstperc,
			saledetail.unitsalestax,
			saledetail.rowgroup,
			saledetail.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable,
			item.customicode,
			users.username
ORDER BY MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_totaldiscval
objects.expression: Sum ( (  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice - looseqty * itemflatdisc )  *  saledetail_discperc  * .01  ) + sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum (  c_amount for all )  * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )

objects.name: compute_16
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0) +totaltaxoninv

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: cashreceived -( (Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)) + totaltaxoninv)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: ((  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice -  looseqty *  itemflatdisc )  *  ( 1 -  (   saledetail_discperc  * .01 )  )  +round( c_amount  *  itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2))/ if(looseqty=0,1,looseqty)

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: (  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice -  looseqty *  itemflatdisc )  *  ( 1 -  (   saledetail_discperc  * .01 )  )  +round( c_amount  *  itemgstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * itemunitsalestax ,2)
